        set_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_designation_col_capital_nomad_factory
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {  has_designation = col_capital_nomad_trade }
        set_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_designation_col_capital_nomad_trade
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {  has_designation = col_nomad_trophy_machine }
        set_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_designation_col_nomad_trophy_machine
    }
}

bca_helper_temp_num_zones_subtract_one = {
    subtract_variable = {
        which = temp_num_zones
        value = 1
    }
}


bca_secondary_zone_setting_set_by_current_zones_helper = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = { has_carrier_flag = tp_zone_processed_z3 }
            has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_zone_district_z3_$DISTRICT$
            check_variable = {
                which = temp_num_zones
                value > 0
            }
        }
        set_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_type_z3_$TYPE$
        set_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_z3_$ZONE$
        set_carrier_flag = tp_zone_processed_z3
        export_trigger_value_to_variable = {
            trigger = num_districts
            parameters = { type = $DISTRICT$ }
            variable = bca_ps_plan_district_count_z3
        }
        subtract_variable = {
            which = temp_num_zones
            value = 1
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = { has_carrier_flag = tp_zone_processed_z4 }
            has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_zone_district_z4_$DISTRICT$
            check_variable = {
                which = temp_num_zones
                value > 0
            }
        }
        set_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_type_z4_$TYPE$
        set_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_z4_$ZONE$
        set_carrier_flag = tp_zone_processed_z4
        export_trigger_value_to_variable = {
            trigger = num_districts
            parameters = { type = $DISTRICT$ }
            variable = bca_ps_plan_district_count_z4
        }
        subtract_variable = {
            which = temp_num_zones
            value = 1
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = { has_carrier_flag = tp_zone_processed_z5 }
            has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_zone_district_z5_$DISTRICT$
            check_variable = {
                which = temp_num_zones
                value > 0
            }
        }
        set_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_type_z5_$TYPE$
        set_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_z5_$ZONE$
        set_carrier_flag = tp_zone_processed_z5
        export_trigger_value_to_variable = {
            trigger = num_districts
            parameters = { type = $DISTRICT$ }
            variable = bca_ps_plan_district_count_z5
        }
        subtract_variable = {
            which = temp_num_zones
            value = 1
        }
    }
}


bca_secondary_zone_setting_set_by_current_zones = {
    optimize_memory
    hidden_effect = {
        bca_planet_setting_clear_zone_selection = {
            ZONE_SLOT = z3
        }
        bca_planet_setting_clear_zone_selection = {
            ZONE_SLOT = z4
        }
        bca_planet_setting_clear_zone_selection = {
            ZONE_SLOT = z5
        }
        bca_set_secondary_district_type_flag = yes
        if = {
            limit = {
                check_variable_arithmetic = {
                    which = value:num_secondary_zones_of_type_urban
                    value > 0
                }
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    check_variable_arithmetic = {
                        which = value:num_zones_of_zone_subterranean_urban
                        value > 0
                    }
                }
                export_trigger_value_to_variable = {
                    trigger = num_zones
                    parameters = { type = zone_subterranean_urban }
                    variable = temp_num_zones
                }
                bca_secondary_zone_setting_set_by_current_zones_helper = {
                    TYPE = urban
                    ZONE = zone_subterranean_urban
                    DISTRICT = district_mining
                }
                bca_secondary_zone_setting_set_by_current_zones_helper = {
                    TYPE = urban
                    ZONE = zone_subterranean_urban
                    DISTRICT = district_melting
                }
                bca_secondary_zone_setting_set_by_current_zones_helper = {
                    TYPE = urban
                    ZONE = zone_subterranean_urban
                    DISTRICT = district_hollow_mountains
                }
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    check_variable_arithmetic = {
                        which = value:num_zones_of_zone_agrarian_anglers
                        value > 0
                    }
                }
                export_trigger_value_to_variable = {
                    trigger = num_zones
                    parameters = { type = zone_agrarian_anglers }
                    variable = temp_num_zones
                }
                bca_secondary_zone_setting_set_by_current_zones_helper = {
                    TYPE = urban
                    ZONE = zone_agrarian_anglers
                    DISTRICT = district_farming
                }
                bca_secondary_zone_setting_set_by_current_zones_helper = {
                    TYPE = urban
                    ZONE = zone_agrarian_anglers
                    DISTRICT = district_orchard_forests
                }
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                check_variable_arithmetic = {
                    which = value:num_secondary_zones_of_type_trade
                    value > 0
                }
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    check_variable_arithmetic = {
                        which = value:num_zones_of_zone_trade_arcology
                        value > 0
                    }
                }
                export_trigger_value_to_variable = {
                    trigger = num_zones
                    parameters = { type = zone_trade_arcology }
                    variable = temp_num_zones
                }
                bca_secondary_zone_setting_set_by_current_zones_helper = {
                    TYPE = trade
                    ZONE = zone_trade_arcology
                    DISTRICT = district_arcology_urban_1
                }
                bca_secondary_zone_setting_set_by_current_zones_helper = {
                    TYPE = trade
                    ZONE = zone_trade_arcology
                    DISTRICT = district_arcology_urban_2
                }
                bca_secondary_zone_setting_set_by_current_zones_helper = {
                    TYPE = trade
                    ZONE = zone_trade_arcology
                    DISTRICT = district_arcology_urban_3
                }
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    check_variable_arithmetic = {
                        which = value:num_zones_of_zone_trade_ring_world
                        value > 0
                    }
                }
                export_trigger_value_to_variable = {
                    trigger = num_zones
                    parameters = { type = zone_trade_ring_world }
                    variable = temp_num_zones
                }
                bca_secondary_zone_setting_set_by_current_zones_helper = {

bca_primary_zone_setting_set_by_current_zones_helper = {
    export_trigger_value_to_variable = {
        trigger = num_zones
        parameters = { type = $ZONE$ }
        variable = temp_num_zones
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = { has_carrier_flag = tp_zone_processed_z1 }
            check_variable = {
                which = temp_num_zones
                value > 0
            }
        }
        set_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_type_z1_$TYPE$
        set_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_z1_$ZONE$
        set_carrier_flag = tp_zone_processed_z1
        bca_helper_temp_num_zones_subtract_one = yes
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = { has_carrier_flag = tp_zone_processed_z2 }
            check_variable = {
                which = temp_num_zones
                value > 0
            }
        }
        set_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_type_z2_$TYPE$
        set_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_z2_$ZONE$
        set_carrier_flag = tp_zone_processed_z2
        bca_helper_temp_num_zones_subtract_one = yes
    }
}


bca_primary_zone_setting_set_by_current_zones = {
    hidden_effect = {
        bca_planet_setting_clear_zone_selection = {
            ZONE_SLOT = z1
        }
        bca_planet_setting_clear_zone_selection = {
            ZONE_SLOT = z2
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                check_variable_arithmetic = {
                    which = value:num_primary_zones_of_type_urban
                    value > 0
                }
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    check_variable_arithmetic = {
                        which = value:num_zones_of_zone_urban
                        value > 0
                    }
                }
                bca_primary_zone_setting_set_by_current_zones_helper = {
                    TYPE = urban
                    ZONE = zone_urban
                }
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                check_variable_arithmetic = {
                    which = value:num_primary_zones_of_type_trade
                    value > 0
                }
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    check_variable_arithmetic = {
                        which = value:num_zones_of_zone_trade
                        value > 0

bca_sync_primary_zone_selection_match = {
    optimize_memory
    export_trigger_value_to_variable = {
        trigger = num_zones
        parameters = { type = $ZONE$ }
        variable = temp_num_zones
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_z1_$ZONE$
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                check_variable = { which = temp_num_zones value > 0 }
            }
            set_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_zone_selection_matched_z1
            subtract_variable = { which = temp_num_zones value = 1 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = {
                check_variable = { which = bca_num_free_zones_d0 value > 0 }
            }
            subtract_variable = { which = bca_num_free_zones_d0 value = 1 }
        }
        else = {
            set_carrier_flag = tp_zone_sync_rewrite_z1
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_z2_$ZONE$
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                check_variable = { which = temp_num_zones value > 0 }
            }
            set_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_zone_selection_matched_z2
            subtract_variable = { which = temp_num_zones value = 1 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = {
                check_variable = { which = bca_num_free_zones_d0 value > 0 }
            }
            subtract_variable = { which = bca_num_free_zones_d0 value = 1 }
        }
        else = {
            set_carrier_flag = tp_zone_sync_rewrite_z2
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            check_variable = { which = temp_num_zones value > 0 }
        }
        set_variable = {
            which = tp_zone_sync_primary_unmatched_$ZONE$
            value = temp_num_zones
        }
    }
}


bca_sync_secondary_zone_selection_match = {
    optimize_memory
    export_trigger_value_to_variable = {
        trigger = num_zones
        parameters = { type = $ZONE$ }
        variable = temp_num_zones
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_z3_$ZONE$
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                bca_sync_secondary_$ZONE$_is_compatible = {
                    ZONE_SLOT = z3
                }
                check_variable = { which = temp_num_zones value > 0 }
            }
            set_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_zone_selection_matched_z3
            subtract_variable = { which = temp_num_zones value = 1 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = {
                bca_sync_secondary_$ZONE$_is_compatible = {
                    ZONE_SLOT = z3
                }
                check_variable = { which = bca_num_free_zones_secondary value > 0 }
            }
            subtract_variable = { which = bca_num_free_zones_secondary value = 1 }
        }
        else = {
            set_carrier_flag = tp_zone_sync_rewrite_z3
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_z4_$ZONE$
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                bca_sync_secondary_$ZONE$_is_compatible = {
                    ZONE_SLOT = z4
                }
                check_variable = { which = temp_num_zones value > 0 }
            }
            set_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_zone_selection_matched_z4
            subtract_variable = { which = temp_num_zones value = 1 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = {
                bca_sync_secondary_$ZONE$_is_compatible = {
                    ZONE_SLOT = z4
                }
                check_variable = { which = bca_num_free_zones_secondary value > 0 }
            }
            subtract_variable = { which = bca_num_free_zones_secondary value = 1 }
        }
        else = {
            set_carrier_flag = tp_zone_sync_rewrite_z4
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_z5_$ZONE$
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                bca_sync_secondary_$ZONE$_is_compatible = {
                    ZONE_SLOT = z5
                }
                check_variable = { which = temp_num_zones value > 0 }
            }
            set_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_zone_selection_matched_z5
            subtract_variable = { which = temp_num_zones value = 1 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = {
                bca_sync_secondary_$ZONE$_is_compatible = {
                    ZONE_SLOT = z5
                }
                check_variable = { which = bca_num_free_zones_secondary value > 0 }
            }
            subtract_variable = { which = bca_num_free_zones_secondary value = 1 }
        }
        else = {
            set_carrier_flag = tp_zone_sync_rewrite_z5
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            check_variable = { which = temp_num_zones value > 0 }
        }
        set_variable = {
            which = tp_zone_sync_secondary_unmatched_$ZONE$
            value = temp_num_zones
        }
    }
}


bca_sync_primary_zone_selection_fill_slot = {
    optimize_memory
    if = {
        limit = {
            check_variable = {
                which = tp_zone_sync_primary_unmatched_zone_urban
                value > 0
            }
        }
        set_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_type_$ZONE_SLOT$_urban
        set_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_$ZONE_SLOT$_zone_urban
        set_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_zone_selection_matched_$ZONE_SLOT$
        subtract_variable = {
            which = tp_zone_sync_primary_unmatched_zone_urban
            value = 1
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            check_variable = {
                which = tp_zone_sync_primary_unmatched_zone_trade
                value > 0
            }
        }
        set_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_type_$ZONE_SLOT$_trade
        set_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_$ZONE_SLOT$_zone_trade
        set_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_zone_selection_matched_$ZONE_SLOT$
        subtract_variable = {
            which = tp_zone_sync_primary_unmatched_zone_trade
            value = 1
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            check_variable = {
                which = tp_zone_sync_primary_unmatched_zone_industrial
                value > 0
            }
        }
        set_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_type_$ZONE_SLOT$_industrial
        set_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_$ZONE_SLOT$_zone_industrial
        set_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_zone_selection_matched_$ZONE_SLOT$
        subtract_variable = {
            which = tp_zone_sync_primary_unmatched_zone_industrial
            value = 1
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            check_variable = {
                which = tp_zone_sync_primary_unmatched_zone_foundry
                value > 0
            }
        }
        set_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_type_$ZONE_SLOT$_foundry
        set_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_$ZONE_SLOT$_zone_foundry

        clear_variable = tp_zone_sync_primary_unmatched_zone_research_unity
        clear_variable = tp_zone_sync_primary_unmatched_zone_habitat_research_unity
        clear_variable = tp_zone_sync_primary_unmatched_zone_unity
        clear_variable = tp_zone_sync_primary_unmatched_zone_unity_bio_trophy

            set_carrier_flag = tp_secondary_zone_selection_synced
            bca_sync_secondary_zone_selection_fill_slot = {
                ZONE_SLOT = z3
            }
        }
        remove_carrier_flag = tp_zone_sync_rewrite_z3
        if = {
            limit = {
                NOT = { bca_has_zone_plan = { ZONE_SLOT = z4 } }
            }
            set_carrier_flag = tp_zone_sync_rewrite_z4
        }
        if = {
            limit = { has_carrier_flag = tp_zone_sync_rewrite_z4 }
            bca_planet_setting_clear_zone_selection = {
                ZONE_SLOT = z4
            }
            set_carrier_flag = tp_secondary_zone_selection_synced
            bca_sync_secondary_zone_selection_fill_slot = {
                ZONE_SLOT = z4
            }
        }
        remove_carrier_flag = tp_zone_sync_rewrite_z4
        if = {
            limit = {
                NOT = { bca_has_zone_plan = { ZONE_SLOT = z5 } }
            }
            set_carrier_flag = tp_zone_sync_rewrite_z5
        }
        if = {
            limit = { has_carrier_flag = tp_zone_sync_rewrite_z5 }
            bca_planet_setting_clear_zone_selection = {
                ZONE_SLOT = z5
            }
            set_carrier_flag = tp_secondary_zone_selection_synced
            bca_sync_secondary_zone_selection_fill_slot = {
                ZONE_SLOT = z5
            }
        }
        remove_carrier_flag = tp_zone_sync_rewrite_z5
        if = {
            limit = {
                OR = {
                    has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_zone_selection_matched_z3
                    has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_zone_selection_matched_z4
                    has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_zone_selection_matched_z5
                }
            }
            set_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_zone_selection_matched_zx
        }
        if = {
            limit = { has_carrier_flag = tp_secondary_zone_selection_synced }
            bca_set_zx_for_identical_secondary_zone_plan = yes
        }
        remove_carrier_flag = tp_secondary_zone_selection_synced
        bca_clean_flags_zone_selector_secondary_district = yes
        clear_variable = temp_num_zones
        clear_variable = bca_num_free_zones_secondary
        clear_variable = tp_zone_sync_secondary_unmatched_zone_subterranean_urban
        clear_variable = tp_zone_sync_secondary_unmatched_zone_agrarian_anglers

    if = {
        limit = {
            has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_type_z3_urban

        set_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_type_zx_wilderness_energy
        if = {
            limit = {
                has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_z3_zone_energy_wilderness
            }
            set_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_zx_zone_energy_wilderness
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_type_z3_wilderness_food
            has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_type_z4_wilderness_food
            has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_type_z5_wilderness_food
        }
        set_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_type_zx_wilderness_food
        if = {
            limit = {
                has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_z3_zone_food_wilderness
            }
            set_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_zx_zone_food_wilderness
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_type_z3_ark_reactor
            has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_type_z4_ark_reactor
            has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_type_z5_ark_reactor
        }
        set_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_type_zx_ark_reactor
        if = {
            limit = {
                has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_z3_zone_ark_engine_bypass
            }
            set_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_zx_zone_ark_engine_bypass
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_type_z3_missile
            has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_type_z4_missile
            has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_type_z5_missile
        }
        set_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_type_zx_missile
        if = {
            limit = {
                has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_z3_zone_ark_missile_silos
            }
            set_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_zx_zone_ark_missile_silos
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_type_z3_gun
            has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_type_z4_gun
            has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_type_z5_gun
        }
        set_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_type_zx_gun
        if = {
            limit = {
                has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_z3_zone_ark_ammunition_lines
            }
            set_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_zx_zone_ark_ammunition_lines
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_type_z3_laser
            has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_type_z4_laser
            has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_type_z5_laser
        }
        set_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_type_zx_laser
        if = {
            limit = {
                has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_z3_zone_ark_laser_capacitors
            }
            set_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_zx_zone_ark_laser_capacitors
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_type_z3_fighter
            has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_type_z4_fighter
            has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_type_z5_fighter
        }
        set_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_type_zx_fighter
        if = {
            limit = {
                has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_z3_zone_ark_flight_decks
            }
            set_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_zx_zone_ark_flight_decks
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_type_z3_forever_cruise_passenger
            has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_type_z4_forever_cruise_passenger
            has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_type_z5_forever_cruise_passenger
        }
        set_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_type_zx_forever_cruise_passenger
        if = {
            limit = {
                has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_z3_zone_ark_forever_cruise_passenger
            }
            set_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_zx_zone_ark_forever_cruise_passenger
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_type_z3_forever_cruise_crew
            has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_type_z4_forever_cruise_crew
            has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_type_z5_forever_cruise_crew
        }
        set_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_type_zx_forever_cruise_crew
        if = {
            limit = {
                has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_z3_zone_ark_shipwright
            }
            set_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_zx_zone_ark_shipwright
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_z3_zone_ark_forever_cruise_crew
            }
            set_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_zx_zone_ark_forever_cruise_crew
        }
    }
    else = {
        set_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_show_detailed_secondary_districts
    }
}
